description: This file defines classes and types related to network requests, responses, and WebSocket handling within the Playwright core library. It includes request interception, response handling, WebSocket communication, and request/response metadata.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, including headers, method, URL, and fallback overrides.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, including status, headers, body, and security details.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection, handling message sending, receiving, and events.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles request interception, aborting, fulfilling, and continuing requests.

classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: Manages WebSocket route interception and communication.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteHandler
classes.description: Defines a handler for WebSocket route interception patterns.

classes.name: RouteHandler
classes.description: Manages request route handling, including stopping and expiration logic.

classes.name: RawHeaders
classes.description: Utility class for managing raw HTTP headers, supporting case-insensitive access.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Returns headers as a Headers object.

methods.name: _actualHeaders
methods.description: Fetches the actual headers from the network request.

methods.name: allHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers as a Headers object.

methods.name: headerValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific header.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Returns the response body as a Buffer.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Parses and returns the response body as JSON.

methods.name: connectToServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the WebSocket server.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops request or WebSocket route handling.

methods.name: prepareInterceptionPatterns
methods.description: Prepares URL patterns for route interception.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the route pattern.
